subject.title: Feature Request: Per-model usage logging for cost tracking

question: What first-phase native usage-ledger contract should OpenClaw own: DB-backed core accounting, plugin-only/event-bus delivery, or deferred native storage?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix chooses persistent storage, privacy boundaries, gateway/API semantics, plugin exposure, backfill behavior, and whether the requested JSONL-style log is allowed under current storage policy.

options.title: Design DB-backed core ledger
options.body: Record completed model-call usage in a canonical state-store ledger with event IDs, source/run/job attribution, no content fields, transcript backfill, and ledger-first usage readers.

options.title: Expose plugin observer first
options.body: Prioritize a narrow provider/plugin model-usage feed and leave native summaries transcript-backed until the storage contract is settled.

options.title: Defer native ledger
options.body: Keep current transcript summaries, diagnostics, and external tools such as burn0 or a ClawHub plugin as the supported path for now.

recommendation.title: Design DB-backed core ledger
recommendation.body: Record completed model-call usage in a canonical state-store ledger with event IDs, source/run/job attribution, no content fields, transcript backfill, and ledger-first usage readers.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history on the existing usage-cost summaries and already provided maintainer-facing guidance on this exact ledger request.
